newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia budget mid-year review early 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia budget mid-year review early 1997.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday the government would conduct its mid-year budget review early in 1997.
"I expect it (the government) will have the mid-year review sometime early in the new year," Costello told reporters.
Costello said the government would wait for the release of the September quarter national accounts on December 4 followed by a round of consultations.
The Liberal-national government's Charter of Budget Honesty said the mid-year review was supposed to come out by the end of December.
The review is a regular annual feature of Australian government forecasting.
